From 76148faa161e7cfb2d7719f35b37d7db4f3f8596 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Andrii Nakryiko <andriin@fb.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2020 18:21:01 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] selftests/bpf: Ensure test flavors use correct skeletons

Ensure that test runner flavors include their own skeletons from <flavor>/
directory. Previously, skeletons generated for no-flavor test_progs were used.
Apart from fixing correctness, this also makes it possible to compile only
flavors individually:

  $ make clean && make test_progs-no_alu32
  ... now succeeds ...

Fixes: 74b5a5968fe8 ("selftests/bpf: Replace test_progs and test_maps w/ general rule")
Signed-off-by: Andrii Nakryiko <andriin@fb.com>
Signed-off-by: Alexei Starovoitov <ast@kernel.org>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/bpf/20200429012111.277390-2-andriin@fb.com

diff --git a/tools/testing/selftests/bpf/Makefile b/tools/testing/selftests/bpf/Makefile
index 4e654d41c7af..01c95f8278c7 100644
--- a/tools/testing/selftests/bpf/Makefile
+++ b/tools/testing/selftests/bpf/Makefile
@@ -324,7 +324,7 @@ $(TRUNNER_TEST_OBJS): $(TRUNNER_OUTPUT)/%.test.o:			\
 		      $(TRUNNER_BPF_SKELS)				\
 		      $$(BPFOBJ) | $(TRUNNER_OUTPUT)
 	$$(call msg,TEST-OBJ,$(TRUNNER_BINARY),$$@)
-	cd $$(@D) && $$(CC) $$(CFLAGS) -c $(CURDIR)/$$< $$(LDLIBS) -o $$(@F)
+	cd $$(@D) && $$(CC) -I. $$(CFLAGS) -c $(CURDIR)/$$< $$(LDLIBS) -o $$(@F)
 
 $(TRUNNER_EXTRA_OBJS): $(TRUNNER_OUTPUT)/%.o:				\
 		       %.c						\
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `Makefile`** 
   - **Modification**: In the target for `$(TRUNNER_TEST_OBJS)`, an additional include directive `-I.` was added to the compiler command. 
   - **Old Command**: 
     ```bash
     cd $$(@D) && $$(CC) $$(CFLAGS) -c $(CURDIR)/$$< $$(LDLIBS) -o $$(@F)
     ```
   - **New Command**: 
     ```bash
     cd $$(@D) && $$(CC) -I. $$(CFLAGS) -c $(CURDIR)/$$< $$(LDLIBS) -o $$(@F)
     ```
   - **Reason for Change**: This modification ensures that the test runner flavors will correctly compile using their own skeletons from their respective directories instead of using a shared skeleton.

### Relationship of Modifications
- The change in the `Makefile` directly addresses the issue of ensuring that test flavors use the appropriate skeletons by modifying the compilation command to include the current directory. This enhancement not only fixes correctness but also enables compilation of flavors individually. The fix is a response to a prior bug noted in commit `74b5a5968fe8`, emphasizing that the previous setup led to incorrect skeleton usage, thus this patch resolves that inconsistency.

Here is the commit message:
selftests/bpf: Ensure test flavors use correct skeletons

Ensure that test runner flavors include their own skeletons from <flavor>/
directory. Previously, skeletons generated for no-flavor test_progs were used.
Apart from fixing correctness, this also makes it possible to compile only
flavors individually:

  $ make clean && make test_progs-no_alu32
  ... now succeeds ...

Fixes: 74b5a5968fe8 ("selftests/bpf: Replace test_progs and test_maps w/ general rule")
Signed-off-by: Andrii Nakryiko <andriin@fb.com>
Signed-off-by: Alexei Starovoitov <ast@kernel.org>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/bpf/20200429012111.277390-2-andriin@fb.com

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the test runner flavors incorrectly using a common set of skeleton files generated for no-flavor test programs instead of their own specific skeletons. This led to compilation failures and incorrect behavior when trying to run tests for specific flavors. The lack of an include directive for the current directory did not allow the compiler to find the correct skeletons for flavor-specific tests.

Reason:
The test runner flavors were using a common set of skeleton files generated for no-flavor test programs, which caused them to fail to find the correct skeletons for flavor-specific tests. The lack of the `-I.` include directive meant that the compiler could not locate the necessary flavor-specific skeleton files in the current directory.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```makefile
cd $$(@D) && $$(CC) -I. $$(CFLAGS) -c $(CURDIR)/$$< $$(LDLIBS) -o $$(@F)
```
Reason:
The addition of the `-I.` directive instructs the compiler to include the current directory in its search path for header files, allowing it to correctly locate and use the flavor-specific skeletons. This change ensures that the correct skeletons are used for compilation, fixing the compilation failures and ensuring the correct behavior of the tests.
